thread:
Jules (PM): Dropped a pared-down Figma for a trace drilldown header. Main questions: where to put exports, how to surface primary correlation ID, and what the copy payload should include. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/trace-header-compact
Rae (Design): Suggest header-right for global exports (Download .json, Copy stack) and a small correlation pill next to the trace title for trace-level actions. Pill shows primary ID + chevron to expand extras.
Ibrahim (Eng): Implementation note: expanding to show full stack will need a fetch unless we preload. Recommend preload for top 3 visible traces, lazy-load others.
Leah (A11y): Accessibility: pill must be keyboard focusable, have aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. Menu items must be buttons with aria-labels like "Copy correlation ID". Announce toast messages via role=status.
Jules (PM): For copy payload: "Trace ID: {{id}}
Service: {{svc}}
Status: {{status}}
Message: {{short_msg}}

Stack:
{{frames}}". Good?
Ibrahim (Eng): Yes. Use flattened frame format: file:line - function. Copy function should call navigator.clipboard.writeText(payload) and fire a lightweight analytics event.
Rae (Design): Microcopy: header action label should read "Download trace (.json)" and "Copy stack (text)". Toast after copy: "Stack copied" with inline "Open trace" link.
Leah (A11y): Ensure contrast tokens for pill meet 4.5:1. For expanded ID lists use role=list and role=listitem. Announce "X more IDs" on trigger.
NotifierBot: deploy:ui/trace-header compact landed in staging at 2026-03-22T17:10Z.
Jules (PM): Actions: Rae update Figma with pill max-width and mobile long-press; Ibrahim spike shortlink endpoint (/go/:id) and copy handler; Leah write a11y acceptance tests. Thanks!
